test_tabular_q: test the tabular Q-learning policy evaluation on the LLVM instcount leaderboard with minimal benchmarks
run_tabular_q_test_main: run the tabular Q-learning test module directly using the test_main entry point
test_eval_llvm_instcount_policy: test the LLVM instcount policy evaluator using the train_and_run function from tabular_q_eval
test_tabular_q_with_flags: test the tabular Q evaluation by configuring absl flags for n, max_benchmarks, nproc, and novalidate
test_tabular_q_system_exit: test that the tabular Q policy evaluation raises SystemExit when run with pytest
